summary.text: Marty O'Donnell is the Republican nominee in Nevada's 3rd District. A composer and audio director best known for the music of the Halo video game series, he has not previously held public office; he finished fourth in the 2024 Republican primary for this seat. His campaign website says he is running on the message that "one good job should be enough."

paragraphs.text: Describes an upbringing in a middle-class family in which his father was a filmmaker and his mother a piano teacher; he studied piano and then composition at Wheaton College and later did graduate study toward a master's degree in music composition, according to a 2026 Nevada Independent interview profile.
Began his career writing music for television and radio commercials, including a Flintstones vitamins jingle.

Became known in the video game industry as composer and sound designer for the Halo series; he was audio director at the game developer Bungie for over a decade, including after Microsoft acquired the studio in 2000 and he moved to Seattle.
Collaborated with Paul McCartney on the orchestral suite Music of the Spheres for the 2014 game Destiny.
Moved to Southern Nevada in 2021; the Nevada Independent reports he has volunteered in positions at the Center for Faith and Culture, a Washington State nonprofit, without salary.
Ran in the 2024 Republican primary for Nevada's 3rd District and placed fourth with 20.4% of the vote, after spending more than $1 million of his own money.
Endorsed by Gov. Joe Lombardo and won the June 9, 2026 Republican primary; he has loaned his campaign $3 million.
